definitions.gloss: to apply, to put against, to press (something) to
definitions.explanation: Describes physically placing something against another surface.

definitions.gloss: to allot, to assign, to allocate, to provide
definitions.explanation: Used when assigning roles, rooms, or resources to someone.

examples.japanese: {傷口|きずぐち}にガーゼをあてがう。
{耳|みみ}に{受話器|じゅわき}をあてがった。
examples.english: I put the receiver to my ear.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}に{定規|じょうぎ}をあてがって{線|せん}を{引|ひ}いた。
examples.english: I drew a line by pressing a ruler against the wall.

examples.japanese: {新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}に{仕事|しごと}をあてがう。
examples.english: Assign work to the new employee.

examples.japanese: {客|きゃく}に{部屋|へや}をあてがった。
examples.english: I allocated a room to the guest.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}には{古|ふる}い{教科書|きょうかしょ}があてがわれた。
examples.english: The children were given old textbooks.

notes:
Usually written in hiragana. Also written as {宛|あ}てがう or {充|あ}てがう.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部屋|へや}をあてがう: to assign a room
- {仕事|しごと}をあてがう: to assign work
